channel.title: Web Design Trend Catalog — Field Notes
channel.description: Essays and teaching guides about web design history.

item.title: Why Web Design Trends Overlap, Return, and React
item.description: A practical model for reading web history as a sequence of overlapping movements, revivals, and counterreactions rather than a clean parade of styles.

item.title: From Skeuomorphism to Flat Design—and Back Toward Tactility
item.description: Trace the movement from realistic materials and physical metaphors to flat interfaces, then toward the restrained depth of Flat 2.0, neumorphism, glassmorphism, and claymorphism.

item.title: A Beginner’s Guide to Early-Web Vernacular
item.description: Learn how document-style pages, personal homepages, badges, frames, tables, and pixel graphics formed the visual language of the early public web.

item.title: How Responsive Design Changed the Structure of Websites
item.description: Follow the structural shift from fixed and fluid desktop layouts to responsive grids, mobile-first priorities, off-canvas navigation, cards, and reusable components.

item.title: Webcore, Y2K Revival, and the Web Recreating Its Own Past
item.description: Compare broad old-web nostalgia with the more specific chrome, bubble, techno, and millennium imagery of the Y2K revival.
